model_assumptions: All4531 original triangles remain, with strictly positive nondegenerate affine UV area in the original corner order.

Charts join only across shared original source edges with source endpoint correspondence and continuous affine UVs; no shared-vertex or nonlocal UV bridges and no disconnected pieces relabelled as one connected chart.
No positive-area UV overlap is permitted exactly. The chart budget counts source-connected charts, one per owned island, rather than aggregating disconnected pieces under one owner ID.
argument: Two positive-area affine triangles sharing the same directed UV edge both lie locally to its left. Gluing a same-directed original incidence-two edge therefore creates positive-area overlap, so it cannot connect two valid charts under this model.

At any one nonmanifold original edge with k face occurrences, each continuous UV edge copy can contain at most one face on either side. Thus at most floor(k/2) disjoint opposite-direction face pairs can be glued.
Start with all4153 permissible incidence-two edges already joined, giving815 components. Every newly permitted nonmanifold pair adjacency can reduce component count by at most one.
For k>=3, floor(k/2)<=k-2, so all219 nonmanifold edges permit at most674-2*219=236 additional pair adjacencies, even optimistically.
Therefore every charting in this exact model has at least815-236=579 connected charts, exceeding256. The forest cycle cuts do not change those815 components.
limitations: This is a conditional exact topological/overlap argument, not an actual unwrap, geometric atlas construction or validation result.

The proof does not establish a numeric lower bound on the positive overlap area. A validator that tolerates overlaps up to1e-12 square texels cannot be declared to reject every possible tiny-overlap construction from this proof alone.
Allowing negative per-face UV orientations, source discontinuity, nonlocal bridges, disconnected pieces under one chart ID or different island semantics changes the model.
The actual tested815-chart conservative candidate is independently BLOCKED by the unchanged256-chart gate and its3338240 prescribed owner-area floor; it does not depend on the generalized579 proof.
